results.description:
🇷🇺🇨🇳 Russia Says It May Agree on Key Gas Link With China This Year

Russia said Gazprom PJSC and China National Petroleum Corp. may reach a commercial agreement by year-end on gas supplies via the Power of Baikal link, a route which has the potential to reshape global energy flows.

“We are waiting for our companies to hold commercial talks,” — Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said. 

“We hope that by year-end they will reach the necessary agreements,” — he said, referring to deliveries via the future route formerly known as Power of Siberia 2.

results.title: 🇨🇳🇷🇺 The future is definitely cooperating with Russia and China.
results.description:
🇨🇳🇷🇺 The future is definitely cooperating with Russia and China. 

Chinese Premier Li Qiang is in St Petersburg for discussions with his counterpart, Russian Premier Mikhail Mishustin, on the issues of trade, economics, industry, energy, culture, and education. 

Li was given a tour of the palaces of Catherine and of Alexander I at the Tsarskoye Selo, and was shown the Chinese Hall of Catherine the Great. 

The palace of Tsarskoye Selo was also the site of the Imperial School, which the young Alexander Pushkin attended and at which he had made his debut as a poet.

They were joined by the Minister of Culture, Olga Lyubimova, and the First Deputy Minister of Finance, Irina Okladinkova.

results.title: Chinese Premier Li Qiang has arrived in St.
results.description:
Chinese Premier Li Qiang has arrived in St. Petersburg, where he was welcomed by Russian PM Mikhail Mishustin, ahead of tomorrow’s 31st regular meeting of the heads of government of Russia and China.

Officials are expected to discuss bilateral trade, energy, industrial cooperation, agriculture and transport infrastructure, with several agreements due to be signed.

results.title: Brazil sold more crude oil to China than Saudi Arabia did between Jan.
results.description:
Brazil sold more crude oil to China than Saudi Arabia did between Jan. and Sep. 2026, becoming Beijing's second-largest supplier after Russia. Chinese customs data released on October 20 show imports of 44.29M tonnes of Brazilian crude over the period.
